# Watch Party

Real-time synchronized video streaming with React + Node.js. Watch YouTube videos together with sub-250ms sync latency.

**Key Features:**
- Real-time video synchronization across unlimited users
- TMDB integration for movie discovery
- Live chat, reactions, and shared playlists
- Automatic drift correction and reconnection handling

**Tech:** React 18 • Socket.io • Node.js • Tailwind CSS

[View Demo](https://github.com/Sajiv17/watch-party) | [Read Docs](docs/)
